title: 🌀 LinkedIn Feed Vanisher
tagline: Say goodbye to the LinkedIn noise. Hello, focus. ✨
warning: Work in progress: This project is under active development and not final. Features, behavior, and instructions may change without notice.
description: LinkedIn Feed Vanisher removes LinkedIn feed UI from the DOM and replaces it with a calm placeholder so you can focus on messaging, jobs, and profiles.

- 🚫 **Blocks the LinkedIn news feed**
- 🔕 **Supports a separate notifications-feed toggle**
- 💾 **Remembers feed preferences** across reloads
- 🔵 **Toolbar badge** reflects active/inactive blocker state
- 🌍 **Cross-browser build with WXT** (Manifest V3 baseline)

comparison.after: You're in control of your attention
Get in, do your thing, get out
